commands:
set -eu
cd /opt/phantom-ebpf
LOG=/var/log/phantom-build-images-20261026T092647Z.log
if sudo -u ubuntu -- env KUBECONFIG=/home/ubuntu/.kube/config bash infra/k8s/k3s-lab/build-images.sh >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
  echo BUILD_EXIT=0
else
  rc=$?
  echo BUILD_EXIT=$rc
  tail -100 "$LOG"
  exit "$rc"
fi
echo IMAGE_IDS
for image in phantom/api-gateway:latest phantom/causal-engine:latest phantom/sbom-service:latest phantom/ebpf-agent:latest phantom/evidence-sink:latest; do docker image inspect --format '{{.RepoTags}} {{.Id}}' "$image"; done
echo CONTAINERD_IMAGES
sudo k3s ctr -n k8s.io images list | grep 'phantom/'
echo DISK
 df -h /
